feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 May 2026 4:25pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 09 May 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low over the Norwegian Sea. High to the far west of Ireland, with a ridge to Hebrides.


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northeast 4 or 5 at first, but 5 or 6 in the west of the area, then decreasing Northeast 3 or 4 later tonight or at first tomorrow morning. Backing North or Northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight later tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 or 4, increasing Northwest 4 or 5 tomorrow evening or overnight, then veering and decreasing North or Northeast 3 or 4 on Monday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy light rain and drizzle for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle for a time.
